findings.text: RIGHT row 15, program 56: the controller first moves the arm 1 deg to the program's first point, at its Start % (30 %): that move takes 0.5-0.6 s on the robot, which widens this arm's timing from here.
The lid and seat tasks are ALIX's plans, made with the UGV at 250 mm from the commode and no offset: place the UGV there for them (Lite cannot see the placement).

Open the lid, then each arm's pole and hand back to before Open the lid (45.7-104.1 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner checked it with the commode's contact allowances); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real.
